confusion_matrix.normalization: divide each row by its actual support; null row when support is zero

coverage: One prediction from each frozen model for every eligible test record; align by catalog_id. Missing, duplicate, unexpected or invalid predictions leave the primary comparison incomplete. No successful-row subset.
difference_units: raw score differences; accuracy differences may additionally be displayed in percentage points
failure_policy: Preserve all attempted outputs. Low performance does not permit tuning, relabeling, dropping records, selecting another seed or rerunning a completed model. A confirmed technical defect needs a versioned amendment and exposure record.
input_policy: Join the nonempty prepared exercise name and any nonempty description by two newline characters; use saved preprocessing only. Targets and metadata stay out of features. Retain valid name-only, unknown-token and all-zero-TF-IDF inputs.
label_policy: Primary scores retain the frozen benchmark targets; disputed labels remain documented limitations. Any sensitivity analysis uses a separate version and the same saved predictions.
neural_inference: Saved seed-42 best-validation state; model.eval(), gradients disabled, no shuffle, no dropped last batch. Class index zero remains a real class.

uncertainty.draws_per_resample: number of distinct eligible test groups; sample with replacement
uncertainty.incomplete_or_empty: Unavailable with an explicit reason; no silent discarded samples or fabricated zero scores
uncertainty.interpretation: Constructed-benchmark sensitivity only; no real-athlete, training-seed or formal-significance claim
uncertainty.interval: individual percentile intervals at 2.5 and 97.5; linear percentile method
uncertainty.members: Every member of each drawn group, retaining draw multiplicity; use the same row indexes for all models
uncertainty.missing_classes: Retain the full frozen class list and zero_division convention
uncertainty.recalculate: Recompute record-level metrics on every paired resample using all frozen classes and zero_division=0; never average group F1 values

weighting: record-level; equal weight per class for macro-F1
